description: The messenger, and a thicker note

participation.context: Set Nick's two beats, asked for the plain voice, and left the new page at home.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Cleared Sincler's line and took the twelvemonth plain.
participation.name: Richard Burbage

participation.context: Held the two beats and spoke "Dead for my life."
participation.name: Nick Sorrell

participation.context: Put the line on Nick's chest, and stopped Sam after one thick note.
participation.name: Augustine Phillips

participation.context: Walked three paces and stood by the pillar.
participation.name: John Sincler

participation.context: Sang the word through a thick throat, and did not get a second try.
participation.name: Sam Latchet

relations.quote: Sing it on the breath, Sam, not on the word. The word will come along.
That's too long for a play.

story.body: You set the three paces and the two beats, and you had Burbage drop the sonnet voice. Sam sang once, thick, and stopped. You went toward home with no new page.

relations.quote: Sing it on the breath, Sam, not on the word. The word will come along.
That's too long for a play.

title: Rehearsed the messenger, and Sam sang once
